statement: The proof-cone selector runs in shadow mode against a replay corpus of historical Quest attempt diffs: for every replayed diff it derives a selection receipt whose escalation tier and selected set are computed deterministically; every contract-owning change selects at least one claimant of that contract (zero contract-selection misses); every full-suite-tier change selects the complete census; and a synthetic mutation check proves a test covering a changed production file is inside that file's cone. Any selection miss fails the Quest.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
